latestVersion.changelog:
Subtitle Maker Online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Add subtitles and captions to video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Cloud-based AI generates and burns in captions for YouTubers and content creators.
- Supports multiple languages, auto-sync, and 1080p MP4 exports.
- Upload and process video files directly in chat, with typical completion in 30–90 seconds.
- Check credits, view timeline state, and manage exports through intuitive chat commands.
- Includes robust error handling and clear, instructive user feedback.
